headline: Indian Rupee Rallies to Two-Month High of 93.89 Against US Dollar
summary: The Indian rupee appreciated 52 paise to close at 93.89 per US dollar, supported by declining US Treasury yields, softening crude oil prices, and foreign capital inflows into domestic financial markets.
why: The value of the Indian rupee affects imported energy inflation and international investment flows into South Asia.

impacts.name: Indian Rupee
impacts.why: Lower oil prices and foreign portfolio purchases fueled a five-day gain for the domestic currency.
